name: @tomgrv/vps-access
description: Confirm which services are public or internal, and the DNS names they use

SYSTEM_EXTERNAL_DOMAIN.description: Wildcard DNS domain pointing at this VPS (empty = <public-ip>.nip.io fallback)

SYSTEM_INTERNAL_DOMAIN.description: DNS domain of the internal address, for internal services (empty = external)

SYSTEM_ACCESS_MENU.description: Ask to confirm visibilities and DNS (true/false); false keeps saved or defaults

SYSTEM_INTERNAL_APPS.description: Comma list of apps served on the internal network only (e.g. rancher,coder)

SYSTEM_PUBLIC_APPS.description: Comma list of apps served on the server IP; overrides the menu and defaults
